mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is at a historically low level (1.16%), which compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 245.0 (current value 245.03) signals persistent inflation, which triggers central bank tightening and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 245.0).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising industrial production (INDPRO) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong economic growth, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of INDPRO rising and UNRATE falling does not produce positive returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising), high industrial production (INDPRO) indicates economic resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising and INDPRO > 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% (current value 4.4) signals economic weakness, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.5).

mechanism_narrative: The current level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) is at 146,730.0 thousand, indicating strong labor market conditions, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS is above 140,000.0.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts (HOUST) and rising residential sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of HOUST rising and RSAFS rising does not produce positive returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 annual growth rate above 2.0%), high housing starts (HOUST) signals continued consumer strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 annual growth rate > 2.0% and HOUST > 1100.0.
